html:
A coup attempt in the Gambia on 30 July 1981, led by the leftist Kukoi Samba Sanyang while President Dawda Jawara was in London for a royal wedding.

The rebels seized much of Banjul and took hostages. Jawara asked Senegal for help under a defence pact, and Senegalese troops put the revolt down within about a week. Hundreds of people died. The country had no army of its own before this. The rescue led directly to the Senegambia Confederation the next year and to a new Gambian army, the force that later carried out the 1994 coup.
sum: A coup attempt in the Gambia on 30 July 1981, led by the leftist Kukoi Samba Sanyang while President Dawda Jawara was in London for a royal wedding.
